description: Na₂VO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.47 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-17°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-14°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-15°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄V₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-15°.
